answers.solution: The Mandu Festival is held at Mandu (Mandav), in Dhar district of Madhya Pradesh. So the answer is Madhya Pradesh.
The Godavari is the longest river of South India, so it is called Dakshin Ganga (the Ganga of the South). So the answer is Godavari.
A narrow strip of land joining two larger land masses is an isthmus, such as the Isthmus of Panama. So the answer is isthmus.
The currency of Bangladesh is the Taka. So the answer is Taka.
The Bay of Bengal, to the east of India, is the largest bay in the world. So the answer is the Bay of Bengal.
